sn35.131:1.1: susumāragire bhesakaḷāvane → suṁsumāragire bhesakalāvane (bj, pts) | susumāragire → sasumāragire (sya-all) | Suṁsumāragire → B1-2 susu-; B2 -gīre (pts note) | Bhesakalāvane → S1-3 -kaḷā- (pts note)
sn35.131:1.5: rūpā- → As in No. 118. This sutta being the sixth in which this subject is dealt with, I do not repeat the usual development (pts note)
